newsitem.title: NIGERIA: SOCCER-OLYMPIC CHAMPIONS NIGERIA TURN DOWN CHANCE TO PLAY BRAZIL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-OLYMPIC CHAMPIONS NIGERIA TURN DOWN CHANCE TO PLAY BRAZIL.

text.p: Olympic champions Nigeria have turned down an invitation from Brazil, the side they beat in the semifinals in Atlanta, to play a friendly later this year.
"We are not anxious to meet them now," sports minister Jim Nwobodo said of the request from Brazilian soccer authorities.
Nwobodo said world champions Brazil were still in trauma over their 4-3 Olympic semifinal defeat by Nigeria and wanted to restore their "dominance claim on world soccer".
"We will take our time in honouring Brazil's invitation since we are aware of their motive," he said.
"No matter what Brazil think, Nigeria are the current world champions."
